instance.description: Specific settings for this Multiverse instance.

deployment_mode.description: Deployment mode. 'monolith' runs all services in one process (fluxer_server). 'microservices' requires separate processes/ports.

auto_join_invite_code.description: Invite code to auto-join users to a guild upon registration.

private_key_path.description: Path to the x25519 private key for E2E encryption (generated on first startup if missing).

federation.description: Federation configuration for connecting with other Multiverse instances.

enabled.description: Enable federation with other Multiverse instances.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for a scan result (ms).

max_entries_per_batch.description: Maximum queue entries to process per consumer run.

require_forwarded_for.description: Reject API requests that arrive without a proxy-set client IP header (X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For, or CF-Connecting-IP when trust_cf_connecting_ip is on). Defaults to false because it must only be enabled when EVERY path to the API passes through a reverse proxy that sets one of those headers; a deployment reached directly on its port (including `devenv up`) rejects every request with 403 when this is on. The official deployment's nginx sets X-Real-IP and X-Forwarded-For on all proxied locations, so it can turn this on for defence in depth against requests that reach the app port without going through nginx.
